notes.required: A required key must be present or the whole document fails to decode on the phone and the watch. A required key without a default has no fixed starting value: the editor supplies one (an id, the entity, the name).
notes.default: On a required key: the value a new item carries. On an optional key: what an absent key means. An optional key with no default has no single meaning when absent (it depends on the tile kind or a global setting).
notes.new: On an optional key: the value the phone writes on a new item when that differs from what an absent key means.
notes.strict: An unknown enum value makes the whole document unreadable unless the key says strict false. On a strict false key the app keeps or ignores a value it does not know.
notes.writeWhen: The phone writes the key only when the condition holds: not means the named key differs from the value, gt means it is greater, present means the named key is set. A key left out decodes to its default.
notes.uuid: Ids are UUID strings in upper case, as the phone writes them (8-4-4-4-12 hex digits). Write new ids in upper case so the phone's own encoding of the document does not change.
notes.color: A color is "#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA". Also seen: the same without "#" (multiCamBorderColor defaults to "FFFFFF"), "GRADIENT|#RRGGBB|#RRGGBB" for a two color gradient, "#RAINBOW", and "#THEME" in borderColor for the theme gradient. Older documents can hold a color name (yellow, blue, red, green, purple, orange, white).
notes.number: JSON number. The phone writes whole values without a fraction (1, not 1.0).
notes.slideMap: A dictionary keyed by hold and slide direction is a flat JSON array of pairs: [direction, value, direction, value]. Directions are the SlideDirection values and are strict. A JSON object in its place makes the document unreadable. A writer puts the pairs in the order up, down, left, right; a reader must accept any order.
notes.map: A JSON object with string keys. stateIcons and stateColors are keyed by the lower case Home Assistant state ("unavailable" also covers unknown); calendarSourceColors is keyed by calendar entity id.
notes.tileKind: A tile has no type field. Its kind is the part of entityId before the first dot: a Home Assistant domain, or one of the virtual kinds.

virtualKinds.divider: divider.<style>.<domain>[.g<glow>]: style is line or label, domain names the section, glow is 0 to 100 (percent). The label text is customLabel, else the domain name.
virtualKinds.page: page.<page id>, switches to that page.
virtualKinds.show_page: show_page.<page id>, shows that page on top of the current one.
virtualKinds.status_page: status_page.<status page id>, opens a status page kept on the phone.
virtualKinds.http_action: http_action.<action id>, fires an HTTP action kept on the phone.
virtualKinds.macro: macro.<macro id>, runs a macro kept on the phone.
virtualKinds.template: template.<UUID>, shows the result of templateString.
virtualKinds.webhook_inbox: webhook_inbox.all; webhook_inbox.<topic> is reserved for a single topic.

notes.grid: Placement is absolute on a 12 column grid: gridCol 0 to 11, gridRow from 0, colSpan 1 to 12, rowSpan from 1. Nothing in the decoder stops overlaps.
notes.pageIds: Every page needs a unique id. A page without one gets a new id on every decode; duplicate page ids crash the watch.
